vocab_words.example: The company handled the complaint promptly.
Customers can request a refund within 30 days.
We received an inquiry about the product warranty.

vocab_words.meaning: phản hồi, ý kiến đóng góp
vocab_words.example: Customer feedback helps us improve our service.
The staff were courteous and helpful.
The team worked to resolve the issue quickly.
The warehouse conducts inventory checks monthly.
The shipment is expected to arrive next week.
Defective items are returned to the manufacturer.
We switched to a more reliable supplier.

items.question: The airline apologized ___ the inconvenience caused by the delay.
Customers can track their orders ___ our new mobile application.
items.explanation: "Through" nghĩa là thông qua, bằng phương tiện gì.

items.question: Our supplier can deliver the goods ___ two business days.
items.explanation: "Within" dùng để chỉ khoảng thời gian giới hạn (trong vòng).

items.question: The client requested that the invoice ___ sent by email.
items.explanation: Câu giả định (subjunctive) sau "request that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: She is responsible ___ managing the entire logistics department.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be responsible for + V-ing/danh từ".

items.question: The new policy will take effect ___ the beginning of next month.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "at the beginning of" dùng giới từ "at".

items.question: The client was pleased ___ the quality of the final product.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be pleased with something".

items.question: The new regulations ___ affect small businesses more than large corporations.
items.explanation: Trạng từ "likely" thường đứng giữa trợ động từ "will" và động từ chính.

items.question: The company's success can be ___ to its strong leadership.
items.explanation: Thể bị động: "be attributed to something" nghĩa là được cho là do.

items.question: The company's profits have grown steadily ___ the past five years.
items.explanation: "Over the past + khoảng thời gian" diễn tả một quá trình kéo dài.
